promotion.reason: Step 5 is offline component validation. Proxy labels and one training weekend do not establish physical-arrival or journey performance.

known_limitations: Validation has weekdays only; final-test weekend must not select model settings.
Already-past forecasts and horizons beyond 30 minutes are outside the source dataset.
Archived alert groups describe as-of evidence; unknown alerts are not normal service.
No model predicts passenger walking, full journey outcomes or realized route-choice savings.
Prediction-revision histories and alert aggregates are excluded from model inputs until online parity is established.
